title: One target of every material in RI-WPN05 §B, in a line, so the 5x7 hitstop grid is driven rather than declared.

loadout._note: The exemplar build. Materials are set per spawn; RI-WPN05 §B owns the multipliers.

note: W1-10 fixture. Five passive dummies in reach, for RI-WPN05 §A's 5x7 hitstop grid. DECLARED LIMITATION, stated rather than discovered: no enemy statblock in this build carries a `material`, so all five are flesh and this fixture exercises the ATTACKER side (weight tier, shape, poise damage, the live `player.hitstop_f`) against a constant target. The material multiplier and the deflection rule are computable per (weapon, slot, material) through H.weapons.impactFor() and are NOT yet driven by a landed hit; that half of the seam is W1-11's. Scoring the material half 0 fail-closed against this piece is correct.
